svg.title: Numbness or tingling in the hand split by which fingers: the median side goes to carpal tunnel syndrome and the ulnar side to ulnar neuropathy at the wrist in Guyon's canal; each column gives the presentation, causes, the workup that rules out the nerve-root mimic with EMG and nerve conduction studies, and treatment in order
